topoDiscovery.description: Independently selects one discovery implementation and label contract for each topology. Mode is the only enablement switch for its topology writer.

fabricNode.description: Controls how the agent discovers local RDMA and LLDP state and reports it through the FabricNode resource.

refreshInterval.description: Interval between agent refreshes of local RDMA interfaces and LLDP neighbors.

initialScanDelay.description: Delay before the first agent scan, allowing lldpd to learn neighbors.

scaleOutInterfaceSelector.description: RDMA interfaces included in scale-out topology and metrics. Supports selectors such as cidr=172.17.0.0/16 or interface=eth*,!eth9.

storageInterfaceSelector.description: RDMA interfaces classified as storage and excluded from scale-out topology. Leave empty when no dedicated storage RDMA network exists.

scaleUpInterfaceSelector.description: RDMA interfaces classified as scale-up and excluded from scale-out topology. Leave empty when no dedicated scale-up RDMA network exists.

nodeMetrics.description: Controls the agent RDMA metrics endpoint and scrape resources.

enabled.description: Enable RDMA metrics collection and expose the agent metrics Service.

port.description: Container port used by the agent metrics endpoint.

path.description: HTTP path served by the agent metrics endpoint.

serviceMonitor.description: ServiceMonitor settings used by Prometheus Operator to scrape node metrics.

enabled.description: Create a Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor for agent RDMA metrics.

interval.description: Prometheus scrape interval for agent RDMA metrics.

scrapeTimeout.description: Prometheus scrape timeout for agent RDMA metrics.

path.description: HTTP path scraped by the ServiceMonitor.

labels.description: Extra labels added to the ServiceMonitor for Prometheus selection.

service.description: Service settings for exposing agent RDMA metrics inside the cluster.

type.description: Kubernetes Service type for agent RDMA metrics.

port.description: Service port used by Prometheus to scrape agent RDMA metrics.

topologyAPI.description: Controls the read-only Topology HTTP API used by the Unifabric Grafana datasource plugin.

enabled.description: Enable the Topology HTTP API. Disabled by default since it has no authentication of its own.

language.description: Dashboard language to install. en installs the English dashboards, zh the Chinese ones with a -zh suffix on their uid and resource name, all installs both.

kind.description: Dashboard resource kind. Use ConfigMap for Grafana sidecar import, or GrafanaDashboard for Grafana Operator.

labels.description: Extra labels added to rendered dashboard resources.

instanceSelector.description: Grafana Operator instance selector for importing dashboards and the Topology datasource into an external Grafana instance. Ignored when grafanaInstance.enabled is true.

grafanaInstance.description: Controls the optional Grafana instance managed by Grafana Operator. The Grafana Operator CRDs must already be installed.

enabled.description: Apply built-in Grafana instances when enabled.

registry.description: Container image registry for the controller.

repository.description: Container image repository for the controller.

tag.description: Container image tag for the controller. Defaults to the chart appVersion when empty.

pullPolicy.description: Image pull policy for the controller container.

podLabels.description: Extra labels added to controller pods.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for scheduling controller pods.

affinity.description: Affinity rules for scheduling controller pods.

topologyAPI.description: Controller Topology API container, Service, and datasource port. Only listened on when topologyAPI.enabled is true.

enabled.description: Create a Service for the controller metrics endpoint.

type.description: Kubernetes Service type for the controller metrics endpoint.

logLevel.description: Controller log level. Valid values are debug, info, warn, and error.

bindAddress.description: Controller metrics bind address inside the container.
Controller pprof bind address. Leave empty to disable pprof.

enabled.description: Deploy the Unifabric node agent DaemonSet.

registry.description: Container image registry shared by the agent and lldpd sidecar.

repository.description: Container image repository shared by the agent and lldpd sidecar.

tag.description: Container image tag shared by the agent and lldpd sidecar. Defaults to the chart appVersion when empty.

pullPolicy.description: Image pull policy shared by the agent and lldpd sidecar.

podLabels.description: Extra labels added to agent pods.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for scheduling agent pods.

hostNetwork.description: Run agent pods in the host network namespace.

hostPID.description: Run agent pods in the host PID namespace.

cpu.description: Agent CPU limit. Keep it generous: the agent issues one ethtool ioctl per RDMA interface (PFs and every SR-IOV VF) while holding the kernel rtnl lock, and CFS throttling mid-ioctl stalls other network operations on the node.

logLevel.description: Agent log level. Valid values are debug, info, warn, and error.

bindAddress.description: Agent metrics bind address inside the container.

workloadOwnerRules.description: Third-party workload kinds the agent may read while walking a Pod's ownerReferences to its top-level owner, rendered into the agent-workload-owners ClusterRole with the get verb. Keys are API groups, values their plural resources, user values merge with these defaults so a new controller is one extra key. Kubernetes built-in kinds and unifabric.io resources are covered by the generated agent role.

enabled.description: Enable eBPF-based RDMA flow tracking and export RDMA flow metrics. Requires Linux kernel 5.8 or later with BPF ring buffer and uprobe support.
Emit per-send ring buffer events, send-size metrics, and OTLP rows. Enable only when per-send details are required; cumulative bytes, WR, and QP flow metrics remain available when disabled.

queue.description: Send event rows buffered per sink before new rows are dropped.

batch.description: Send event rows per export batch.

flush.description: Maximum time a partial batch waits before export.

sample.description: Store one send event in every N, metrics still count every event.

aggregate.description: Merge identical submissions of a QP inside this window into one row with a count. 0s stores every submission.

hostStateDir.description: Host directory persisting learned provider callback offsets across agent restarts.

bpffsPath.description: Host bpffs mount holding the pinned qp_infos and qp_stats maps.

pinDir.description: bpffs directory for pinned maps so a restarted agent keeps learned QP state. Empty disables pinning.

offsetCache.description: File persisting learned provider callback offsets, under hostStateDir.

discoveryInterval.description: Fallback interval for scanning new processes and libibverbs libraries.

reportInterval.description: Interval for joining the BPF maps into flow metrics.

enabled.description: Publish one RDMAEndpoint per Pod that holds an RDMA device.

interval.description: Fallback publish interval covering lost events.

minInterval.description: Minimum spacing between event driven RDMAEndpoint updates.

allPods.description: Also publish Pods with their own network namespace. Required on InfiniBand fabrics where peers are addressed by LID.

insecure.description: Use plaintext gRPC for the OTLP endpoint.

timeout.description: Per export timeout for the OTLP exporter.

enabled.description: Run the lldpd sidecar used by the agent to collect LLDP neighbors.

managementIPPattern.description: lldpd management IP pattern written to lldpd.conf. Leave empty to let lldpd choose.

interfaces.description: Interface pattern passed to lldpd for LLDP discovery. Leave empty to let lldpd use its defaults.

txInterval.description: LLDP transmit interval, in seconds, configured for lldpd.

extraConfig.description: Additional raw lldpd configuration appended to lldpd.conf.

ebpfFlowEventCollector.description: OpenTelemetry Collector receives eBPF flow events over OTLP and writes them to ClickHouse and/or Elasticsearch. Agents use this Collector when flowEvents is enabled.

replicas.description: Collector replicas. Agents hold one gRPC connection each, so more replicas than agents stay idle.

registry.description: OpenTelemetry Collector contrib image registry. Only the contrib distribution ships the clickhouse and elasticsearch exporters.

memory.description: Collector memory limit. memory_limiter is derived from it.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for the Collector Pod.

sendBatchSize.description: Records per batch sent to the backends.

timeout.description: Maximum time a partial batch waits.

enabled.description: Create a ServiceMonitor for the Collector's own metrics on port 8888.

interval.description: Scrape interval for the Collector metrics.

labels.description: Extra labels added to the ServiceMonitor.

endpoint.description: Native protocol endpoint of an external ClickHouse, for example tcp://clickhouse.data.svc:9000. Leave empty to deploy the bundled test instance described under bundled instead.

database.description: ClickHouse database holding the send events table.

password.description: ClickHouse password. Defaults to rdma-flow for the bundled test instance. Prefer existingSecret for an external server.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret with a password key used instead of password.

ttlDays.description: Row retention applied by the table TTL.

create.description: Create the database and the strongly typed table with an init container before the Collector starts. The exporter never creates the schema itself.

registry.description: ClickHouse client image used by the schema init container.

bundled.description: Bundled single replica ClickHouse deployed only when endpoint is empty. FOR TESTING ONLY: no replication, no backups, fixed credentials, sized for a few nodes of traffic.

enabled.description: Keep the data directory on a PersistentVolumeClaim so tables survive Pod recreation. false uses an emptyDir.

size.description: Size of the claim, or of the emptyDir limit when persistence is disabled.

storageClassName.description: StorageClass of the claim. Empty uses the cluster default class.

existingClaim.description: Existing PersistentVolumeClaim to mount instead of creating one.

resources.description: Bundled ClickHouse container resources. max_server_memory_usage follows the memory limit.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for the bundled ClickHouse Pod.

tolerations.description: Tolerations for the bundled ClickHouse Pod.

enabled.description: Write send events to Elasticsearch as a data stream.

endpoints.description: HTTP endpoints of an external Elasticsearch, for example http://elasticsearch.data.svc:9200. Leave empty to deploy the bundled test instance described under bundled instead.

password.description: Elasticsearch password. Defaults to rdma-flow for the bundled test instance. Prefer existingSecret for an external cluster.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret with a password key used instead of password.

create.description: Write the index template and ILM policy of the data stream before the Collector starts. The template maps every attribute as keyword or number, disables dynamic mapping and uses date_nanos timestamps.

registry.description: curl image used by the schema init container against an external Elasticsearch. The bundled instance applies the schema from its own Pod.

refreshInterval.description: Refresh interval of the backing indices.

rolloverMaxAge.description: Roll the write index over after this age.

rolloverMaxPrimaryShardSize.description: Roll the write index over when a primary shard reaches this size.

deleteMinAge.description: Delete backing indices this long after rollover.

enabled.description: Create a GrafanaDatasource for the data stream so the flow-sends-es dashboard works. Requires grafanaDashboard.kind GrafanaDashboard.

bundled.description: Bundled single node Elasticsearch deployed only when endpoints is empty. FOR TESTING ONLY: single node, security without TLS, fixed credentials, disk watermarks disabled.

registry.description: busybox image used by the privileged init container raising vm.max_map_count.

enabled.description: Run the elasticsearch-exporter sidecar exposing elasticsearch_* metrics on port 9114 for the dashboards.

javaHeap.description: JVM heap passed as -Xms and -Xmx. Keep it at half of the memory limit or less.

enabled.description: Keep the data directory on a PersistentVolumeClaim. false uses an emptyDir and loses data on Pod recreation.

size.description: Size of the claim, or of the emptyDir limit when persistence is disabled.

storageClassName.description: StorageClass of the claim. Empty uses the cluster default class.

existingClaim.description: Existing PersistentVolumeClaim to mount instead of creating one.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for the bundled Elasticsearch Pod.

tolerations.description: Tolerations for the bundled Elasticsearch Pod.

provider.description: Topology provider settings passed to NVIDIA Topograph.

name.description: Provider name. Use infiniband-k8s for InfiniBand or netq for Spectrum-X.

params.description: Provider-specific parameters, such as apiUrl for netq.

credentialsSecretName.description: Existing Secret containing a credentials.yaml key. Required by the netq provider; credentials are mounted only into the topograph Pod.

useGpuCliqueLabel.description: Use the GPU Operator clique label as the accelerator topology source for infiniband-k8s.

image.description: Shared image used by topograph, node-observer, and node-data-broker.

gpuNodeSelector.description: Selects GPU Nodes observed by node-observer and running node-data-broker.

gpuNodeTolerations.description: Tolerations applied to node-data-broker on selected GPU Nodes.
